title: AnalysisStreamContracts
description: Cloud SSE contracts shared between Engram Android and the FastAPI gateway: structured memory analysis (POST /api/v1/analyze/stream) and grounded memory answers (POST /api/v1/answer/stream). Both endpoints emit AnalysisStreamChunk frames as `data: <json>` lines, terminated by a final `data: [DONE]` line.

model.description: Requested model. Ignored in Vertex AI mode, where the gateway uses ENGRAM_VERTEX_MODEL.

AnswerContext.description: One retrieved memory snippet; its 1-based position in `contexts` is the citation number [n].

AnswerStreamRequest.description: Question answered strictly from on-device retrieved memory snippets; the streamed answer is plain text with inline [n] citations.
